convert_voxels_to_mesh: convert a voxel occupancy tensor to a 3D mesh using the cubify function with a threshold
convert_voxels_to_mesh_centered: convert voxels to a centered mesh with color features using cubify with align center
convert_voxels_to_mesh_corner: convert voxels to a corner-aligned mesh using cubify with align corner mode
unravel_flat_index: unravel a flat linear index into 4D coordinates using the unravel_index function
ravel_multi_index: compute a linear index from 3D coordinates using the ravel_index function
